content.question: Which statement about ROC AUC and PR AUC is correct?
options: ROC AUC is more effective for imbalanced datasets, while PR AUC is more effective for balanced datasets
PR AUC is more effective for imbalanced datasets, while ROC AUC is more effective for balanced datasets
Both metrics are designed only for regression problems
Both metrics are designed only for clustering problems
content.answer: ROC AUC is more effective for imbalanced datasets, while PR AUC is more effective for balanced datasets
